inherits.unchanged: network, OLTC/SC/PV buses and limits, reactive capacity factor 0.3, solver, aggregation, reward, voltage limits

data.processed_source: the v1 15-minute dataset restricted to 2013 dates

pv_capacity.rule: 1.2 times each inverter's raw 3-minute peak over split-A training days

selection_evidence.rule: fixed before screening; training days of split A only; no control-method result used

known_limitations: Original violation rate 5.22% is about half the paper's 10.7%; PV scaling does not close the gap because the Original minimum voltage comes from evening load.

The current DistFlow conic MISOCP is not exact on high-PV days (cone slack up to 0.73 p.u.^2); its AC replay shows overvoltage up to 1.061 p.u. It must be tightened before serving as an optimisation reference.
